about_short_description.short_description: Tharawat Green Exchange is an innovative startup that uses Web3 technology to promote environmental sustainability.

product.name: Carbon Credit Trading Platform
product.description: A blockchain-based platform that enables organizations and individuals to trade carbon credits by funding tree planting projects to offset emissions.

product.name: NFT-based Tree Verification System
product.description: A system that issues NFTs for each planted tree, containing data like GPS location, tree species, project name, and carbon offset value to ensure traceability and security.

product.name: Green Projects Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace listing various tree planting and reforestation projects in Saudi Arabia, facilitating connections between buyers and sellers of carbon credits.
